content: Vihaan Patel inquired about the next steps required following the expiration of his health policy. Anjali Desai responded by outlining the two options available: reinstating the current policy (which requires paying the outstanding premium and providing a declaration of good health) or applying for a new policy (which requires going through underwriting). Anjali also provided an attached document with detailed guidelines and asked Vihaan to confirm his preferred option.

action_items: Review the attached policy guidelines document
Inform the insurance agent of the preferred option (reinstatement or new policy)
